Title / Subject: Institutional Profile, History and Governance
Content / Facts: V.S.B. Engineering College is a self-financing, autonomous technical institution established in 2002 by the V.S.B. Educational Trust (founded in 2000 by Founder-Trustee Mr. V. S. Balsamy, B.Sc., LL.B.). The college was conferred autonomous status in 2023. It is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), affiliated with Anna University (Chennai), accredited by NAAC, and recognized under UGC sections 2(f) and 12(B). The institutional motto is 'HARD WORK IS THE KEY TO SUCCESS'.

Title / Subject: Official Campus Address and Highway Location
Content / Facts: Campus Address: V.S.B. Engineering College, NH – 67 Covai Road, Karudayampalayam Post, Karur – 639 111, Tamil Nadu, India. The institution is situated along the National Highway 67 (Coimbatore–Karur Road), providing highway transit access between Karur, Tiruchirappalli, and Coimbatore.

Title / Subject: Admissions Office and General Campus Contact Channels
Content / Facts: Official Admissions Communication: Email channels include admission@vsbec.com and admission@vsbec.org. Campus postal dispatch: NH – 67 Covai Road, Karudayampalayam Post, Karur – 639 111. Note: Individual personal telephone numbers for faculty and administration officers are not published on open web channels for privacy and security; students and applicants should communicate via the designated admission email or in-person campus reception.

Title / Subject: Academic Departments and Degree Programmes Offered
Content / Facts: Undergraduate (B.E. / B.Tech) Programmes: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI & DS), Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI & ML), Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), Computer Science and Business System (CSBS), Computer and Communication Engineering (CCE), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Mechanical Engineering (MECH), Civil Engineering, and Department of Science & Humanities. Postgraduate (M.E.) Programmes: M.E. Computer Science and Engineering, M.E. Applied Electronics, and M.E. Power Systems Engineering.

Title / Subject: Admissions Eligibility and TNEA Counseling Procedures
Content / Facts: B.E. / B.Tech admission is conducted primarily through the Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA) single-window counseling process administered by the Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE) / Anna University, alongside the Consortium of Self-Financing Professional Colleges quota. TNEA Institution Counseling Code: 2622. General Eligibility: Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) with Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry, adhering to the prescribed aggregate cut-off percentages determined by government guidelines.

Title / Subject: Academic Calendar Schedules and Term Dates
Content / Facts: Specific semester commencement dates, internal assessment testing schedules, semester examination periods, and vacation schedules are issued semester-by-semester as official circulars by the Academic Council and Dean of Academics. Detailed working day calendars for ongoing semesters are not hosted on static public pages and must be referenced directly from official noticeboards or student circulars.
Organization: V.S.B. Engineering College Office of Academic Affairs

Title / Subject: Office of Controller of Examinations (COE) and Autonomous Exam Procedures
Content / Facts: The Office of the Controller of Examinations was formally established in 2023 following autonomous conferment. Responsibilities include: drafting examination timetables, allocating examination halls and invigilators for Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA) tests and End Semester Examinations (ESE), processing and publishing semester results, transmitting eligible candidates' CGPA records to Anna University for degree conferral, and issuing Grade Sheets, Consolidated Marksheets, Transcripts, and CGPA-to-Percentage conversion certificates.

Title / Subject: Faculty Leadership and Department Contact Policy
Content / Facts: Each department is led by a Professor & Head of the Department (e.g., Dr. Sangeetha, HoD / Computer Science and Engineering). Specific faculty mobile numbers and home addresses are private and intentionally withheld from public digital directories. Official department academic queries should be routed through department official desks via the central campus communication office.

Title / Subject: Campus Infrastructure, Utilities, RO Water and Amenities
Content / Facts: The campus infrastructure includes modern lecture halls, smart classrooms with multimedia facilities, dedicated laboratories for each engineering department, a mineral water plant with reverse osmosis (RO) purification supplying drinking and cooking water campus-wide, automated teller machine (ATM) services, cafeteria, medical insurance support, IP-based video surveillance, and backup generator power systems.

Title / Subject: Central Library Collections, Digital Resources and Working Hours
Content / Facts: Established in 2002, the V.S.B. Central Library houses approximately 43,565 book volumes across engineering, technology, and management. It subscribes to 96 national and 96 international journals, alongside audio/visual media and question banks. A dedicated Digital Library with 20 workstations provides access to e-resources via the Anna University E-Resource Consortium (AUERC) and Dolphin OPAC. Working Hours: Monday to Saturday from 8:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.; Holidays from 8:30 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. Circulation/Transaction Timings (Book issue/return): 8:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

Title / Subject: Government Scholarships and Financial Assistance Facilitation
Content / Facts: Eligible enrolled students are guided through statutory government welfare schemes, including Tamil Nadu Government Post-Matric Scholarships for BC/MBC/DNC and SC/ST/SCA students, First Graduate Tuition Fee Concession, 7.5% Government School Student Quota benefits, and Central AICTE Pragati & Saksham scholarship schemes. Official college scholarship circulars and annual disbursement reports are processed through the campus administrative scholarship counter.

Title / Subject: Training & Placement Cell and Corporate Recruitment Record
Content / Facts: The Training & Placement Cell organizes regular campus interview drives, technical workshops, coding bootcamps, and soft-skill corporate readiness training. In recent placement cycles, graduating cohorts secured over 1,177 employment offers. Leading recruiters visiting the campus include TCS (186 offers across multiple salary bands), Capgemini (165 offers), UST Global (94 offers), HCL (135 offers), Mphasis (72 offers), LTM (62 offers), ITC (52 offers), Infosys (32 offers), Cognizant (30 offers), Hexaware (28 offers), Avasoft, Kaar Technologies, and product-based companies offering top packages up to 40 Lakhs.

Title / Subject: Student Co-curricular Clubs, Technical Societies and Cultural Bodies
Content / Facts: The college fosters student skill development through diverse active clubs: Coding Club (hands-on programming challenges, open-source projects, and hackathons), Robotics Club, Electronics Club, Electrical Club, Cultural Club & Fine Arts Club (music, fine arts, drama, dance), Literature Club, Eco Club, Puzzle Club, Photography Club, Entrepreneurship Development Cell (EDC), and Youth Red Cross (YRC).

Title / Subject: Student Regulations, Anti-Ragging Mandate and Grievance Committees
Content / Facts: The institution maintains strict statutory committees in compliance with AICTE, Anna University, and Supreme Court directives: 1. Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad enforcing a zero-tolerance policy against any form of harassment. 2. Grievance Redressal Committee providing structured dispute and complaint redressal. 3. Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) ensuring a safe working and learning environment. Students are required to uphold academic integrity, institutional dress code, and mandatory attendance thresholds as prescribed under Anna University autonomous regulations.

Content / Facts: Official notices regarding examination timetables, seminar registrations, campus recruitment drives, IQAC composition reports, and AICTE mandatory disclosures are published on the announcements section of the official website and on internal departmental display boards.
